title: What a trusted machine's refresher last did (~/.ssh/shipshape/state.json, version 1)
description: Written by the refresher on a trusted machine (fleetledger/fleetledger/refresher/refresh.sh) after every run, atomically, for the Fleet panel's header. A run that failed keeps the last success's time, certificate end and Ship count, and says why in last_error. See contracts/ship-fleet.md, "The refresher on a trusted machine".

machine.description: The name this machine is trusted under (machine.conf); null when its settings could not be read.

last_success.description: When a run last applied a bundle; null: never.

certificate_valid_before.description: When the certificate it last installed lapses; null: none installed.

ships.description: How many Ships the last applied bundle listed.

last_error.description: null after a success; else the one sentence the failed run printed on stderr (printable ASCII).

warning.description: Something it could not do that did not fail the run (hc missing, or a Ship hc could not add or remove), or null.

timestamp.description: UTC, RFC 3339, with a Z suffix.
